amendments_2026_11_22_post_sweep.why: First sweep left COMMODITY unmeasurable (raw futures roll gaps) and scored every cell on raw daily return, which structurally penalises de-risking strategies.

cells_added.name: tsmom_12_1_etf_basket
cells_added.spec: COMMODITY measured on INVESTABLE ETFs (GLD,SLV,CPER,DBA,USO,UNG,CORN,WEAT), not raw futures. Per symbol: long when close/close[-273] (12m, skip 21d) > 0 else flat; equal-weight the 8 nets; 15bps round trip (30bps at 2x); monthly buckets for PF; benchmark DBC.
cells_added.notes: Registered before first run (M-107). Replaces H-210/H-211 for the class: ZC=F prints -23.6% on 07-15 in three separate years and CL=F went negative, so futures series cannot score a strategy. ETF NAV absorbs the roll, so a holder really earns this series.

cells_added.name: xsmom_top3_6m_etf
cells_added.spec: Same 8 investable commodity ETFs; rank by 126-session return every 21 sessions, hold top 3 equal weight, non-selected names flat (exposure <= 1 asserted); 15bps (30bps at 2x); benchmark DBC.
cells_added.notes: Registered before first run (M-107). Cross-sectional variant of the repaired commodity measurement.

cells_added.name: dual_momentum_top2_12m
cells_added.spec: Universe SPY,QQQ,IWM,EFA,EEM,TLT,GLD. Every 21 sessions hold the top 2 by 252-session return, equal weight, ONLY if that return > 0 (absolute momentum filter) else cash; 10bps (20bps at 2x); benchmark SPY.
cells_added.notes: Registered before first run (M-107). Antonacci dual momentum; the only new ETF mechanism added, so the trial count rises by exactly one for this class.

amendments_2026_11_22_post_sweep.gate_note: The strict G6 (excess vs buy-and-hold of the same universe) is unchanged. A volatility-matched comparison is reported alongside it as G6b and is labelled separately; no cell is promoted on G6b alone.
